leaf_morphology.secondary_veins: visible and distinct, appearing to curve towards the leaf margin

traits.notes: The seedling exhibits a distinctive swollen or bumpy texture on the stem and nodes. Several leaves show damage in the form of holes and missing sections along the margins.

data.raw_response:
=== Morphological Assessment Form ===
A. Leaf Arrangement & Architecture
    1. Leaf relative position (alternate / opposite / whorled): opposite (clear paired leaves are visible emerging from the same nodes along the stem in multiple images)
    2. Leaf spacing (clustered / distal): distal (leaves are spaced out along the elongated stem rather than grouped in tight clusters)
B. Leaf Complexity
    3. Leaf complexity (simple / compound): simple (leaves appear as single, undivided blades)
    4. Compound leaf type, ONLY if leaf complexity is compound (odd-pinnate / even-pinnate): N/A
    5. Number of leaflets (integer estimate 2, 4, 8, …): N/A
    6. Leaflet arrangement (opposite / alternate / subopposite): N/A
C. Leaf Morphology
    7. Leaf margin (entire / toothed) AND if toothed (dentate, serrate, etc.): entire (margins appear smooth without distinct teeth)
    8. Leaf shape (elliptic, obovate, lanceolate, etc.): elliptic (leaf is broadly oval with the widest point near the center)
    9. Leaf apex (acute, obtuse, acuminate): acute (tip tapers to a distinct point)
    10. Leaf base (rounded, cordate, cuneate): rounded (base appears generally rounded to slightly obtuse)
    11. Venation type (pinnate / palmate / parallel): pinnate (one main central vein is visible with secondary veins branching off)
    12. Secondary veins (visibility, spacing, number): visible and distinct, appearing to curve towards the leaf margin (arcuate)
    13. Leaf surface features (glabrous, shiny, dull, rugose): shiny (leaf surface reflects light indicating a smooth, glossy texture)
    14. Leaf surface trichomes (present / absent): absent (no visible hairs on the leaf surface)
    15. Petiole length (short / long): short (petioles are present but relatively short compared to the leaf blade)
    16. Petiole features (winged / grooved / terete): terete (petioles appear round in cross-section)
D. Stem & Shoot Traits
    17. Stem type, may not be visible (woody / herbaceous): herbaceous (stem appears green and slender, lacking the thickness of woody tissue)
    18. Stem trichomes (present / absent): present (stem is covered in small, raised bumps or short hairs, giving it a rough texture)
    19. Stem color: green (light green to yellowish-green)
    20. Stem texture (smooth / ridged / lenticellate): rough (due to the visible trichomes/bumps)
E. Other Visible Seedling Traits
    21. Stipules, sometimes visible only in close-up images (present / absent): present (small, scale-like stipules are visible at the nodes in close-up views)
    22. Latex, rarely visible but extremely diagnostic when present (present / not observed): not observed
    23. Pulvinus, for Fabaceae family only (present / absent): absent
    24. Tendrils (present / absent): absent
F. Notes: The seedling exhibits a distinctive swollen or bumpy texture on the stem and nodes. Several leaves show damage in the form of holes and missing sections along the margins.
